data: Are the scores for LC and LC+Rand consistently the same?

The caption states that the figure shows cumulative BLEU scores on the validation set sorted by the sentence-level score difference according to the larger-context model. The lines in the figure represent two different models: LC and LC+Rand. The LC line is solid, while the LC+Rand line is dashed. The y-axis represents the Cumulative BLEU scores, and the x-axis represents the Number of sentences.

From the figure, we can observe that the LC line (solid) and the LC+Rand line (dashed) do not consistently overlap or have the same values throughout the range of the x-axis. Instead, they show distinct patterns with the LC line generally higher than the LC+Rand line. This indicates that the scores for LC and LC+Rand are not consistently the same.
